title: I am blown away that this is a thing
content: When I'm in a mall I am always looking for a hippie store that I know is there but I can't find it. Mall is huge and modern. Many dreams lost in a huge office building desperately having to pee and either not finding a bathroom or I find a disgusting bathroom with no walls or doors. Sometimes the highway goes off the road and I am suddenly driving on a roller-coaster road with no tracks, over thr water. Sometimes my legs work, sometimes they don't. I have had these dreams in various combos every night for years. Even if I can't remember it, I know I dreamed it.
